title: Zero divisors of Gorenstein Rings
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative Artinian ring. We consider two graphs associated to $R$, namely the compressed zero-divisor graph $Γ_E(R)$ and the associate class graph $Γ_A(R)$. Partitioning the vertex set of a zero-divisor graph into its core and its boundary, we count the core vertices that dominate the core. This count is a graph invariant, and we estimate it for $Γ(R)$, $Γ_A(R)$ and $Γ_E(R)$. We prove that the count for $Γ_A(R)$ is bounded below by the count for $Γ_E(R)$, and that the lower bound is attained precisely when $R$ is Gorenstein.
